name: Jalan 16/2, Section 16, Petaling Jaya
source: OpenStreetMap puts Jalan 16/2 Nos. 1 to 26 up to 102 m inside Kuala Lumpur; its line here has not changed since 2017. The houses carry the Petaling Jaya postcode 46350 and the Section 16 street name of Petaling Jaya, property listings place Jalan 16/2 in Section 16, Petaling Jaya, Selangor, and the geoBoundaries ADM2 Petaling shape covers them. The path follows the geoBoundaries ADM2 Kuala Lumpur and Petaling line from its crossing with the OpenStreetMap line to longitude 101.6448, then runs between the Jalan 16/2 houses (postcode 46350) and the Lorong 16/2A houses (postcode 59100, Kuala Lumpur), as their OpenStreetMap addresses give them, and meets the OpenStreetMap line again at longitude 101.6452. It moves the 22 Jalan 16/2 houses, the 8 Jalan Dato Abu Bakar 16/1 houses between them and the OpenStreetMap line, and one building without an address, each whole; every Lorong 16/2A house stays in Kuala Lumpur. The path passes about 1 m from Jalan 16/2 No. 5 and Lorong 16/2A No. 2, the rounding of the map.
